title: Driver Earnings Terms, Clause 6: Instant Cashout
content:
**6.1** Under **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro**, instant cashout is available only on an active earnings account; an account on payout hold cannot cash out.

**6.2** Instant cashout opens after a waiting period: The waiting period is counted in calendar days from the account's opened date: day 1 is the calendar day after it, and cashout is available from the day after the last day of the period. The waiting period is 7 calendar days, counted from the opened date recorded on the earnings account.

**6.3** *Retired clause.* The former clause under which a cashout had to be at least the smallest instant cashout and no more than the available balance, with at most the daily cashout count and the daily instant cashout maximum in total per calendar day in the driver's market time (counting the cashouts of the account dated that day), is no longer in force; the amount and daily limits of a cashout are governed by the current instant cashout basis of the product.

**6.4** *Retired clause.* The former clause under which each cashout booked one fee row, cashouts to the Wayfare debit card costing the Wayfare debit card cashout fee and cashouts to an external debit card being free for the first free external cashouts of the day under the driver's Pro status for the quarter and costing the external debit card cashout fee after that, is no longer in force; the fee of a cashout is governed by the current instant cashout basis of the product.

**6.5** The fee is never waived outside these rules and is not refunded when the driver changes their mind.

**6.6** Cashing out is the driver's own decision and is done by the driver.

**6.7** The figures this clause works with remain those of the product's instant cashout schedule. Two of them are set per Wayfare Pro status:

| Status | External debit card cashout fee (USD) | Free external debit card cashouts per calendar day |
|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Pro Blue | 1.25 | 0 |
| Wayfare Pro Silver | 0.85 | 0 |
| Wayfare Pro Gold | 0.85 | 1 |
| Wayfare Pro Platinum | 0.50 | 1 |
| Wayfare Pro Diamond | 0.50 | 2 |
| Wayfare Pro Diamond Elite | 0.00 | 5 |

## Clauses 6.1 and 6.2 at a glance

| Condition | Read from | Met when |
|---|---|---|
| Account status | The earnings account | The account is active (not awaiting payout setup, not on payout hold, not closed) |
| Waiting period | The opened date on the earnings account | Today is on or after the day after the last day of the 7-day period |

## The waiting period on both sides

| Calendar day, counted from the opened date | Instant cashout available? |
|---|---|
| The opened date | No |
| Day 1 to day 7 (the waiting period) | No |
| Day 8: the day after the last day of the period | Yes |

**Hypothetical dated case.** An earnings account opened on 1 June: day 1 is 2 June and day 7, the last day of the period, is 8 June. Instant cashout is available from 9 June; on 8 June it is not.

superseded_clauses: A cashout must be at least instant_cashout_min_amount and no more than the available balance; at most instant_cashout_daily_count_limit cashouts and instant_cashout_daily_max_amount in total per calendar day in the driver's market time (earnings_msr_cashouts_today).

Each cashout books one fee row: cashouts to the Wayfare debit card cost instant_cashout_fee_wayfare_card; cashouts to an external debit card are free for the first free_external_cashouts_per_day of the day under the driver's Pro status for the quarter, and cost instant_cashout_fee_external after that.
